newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, seen lower with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, seen lower with NYMEX.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices in Asia were untraded at midday on Monday but indicated slightly lower amid a weaker NYMEX complex.
July Brent crude futures on SIMEX were quoted at a wide $19.80/$20.20 per barrel, after London rallied 86 cents to settle at $20.35 on Friday.
NYMEX crude meanwhile was last traded lower as some players booked profits following the technical rally on Friday.
June NYMEX crude was last traded at $21.81, down 31 cents from Friday. July was last traded at $21.87, down 31 cents.
"I think it's just profit taking. I can't see any other reason for it," one broker said.
Traders said they expected limited upside for crude futures because of tightening global refining margins.
